//Logging: Microsoft.AspNetCore stays at Warning because its Information output is several lines per request and says nothing a reviewer needs. HttpLogging is the exception: it is the one request line per request, so it is named back up to Information — a category is matched by longest prefix, so the more specific key wins.
//Archive: Every setting the Archive reads, listed so the full set is visible in one place. docker-compose.yml supplies them as Archive__* environment variables, which outrank this file; the tunable ones default from .env. The two required paths carry no value here on purpose — see below.

Archive.//CabinetsFile: REQUIRED. Path to cabinets.json; absolute, or relative to the content root. Supplied as Archive__CabinetsFile. Deliberately not given a value here, not even null: the key must be absent so startup fails naming the setting.
Archive.//StoragePath: REQUIRED. Directory documents are kept in; it must be a mounted volume. Supplied as Archive__StoragePath. Deliberately not given a value here: a path resolving inside the image would lose data on the next restart.
Archive.//MaxPageSize: Most documents one page of a query may hold. The review demo runs with this set to 5.
Archive.//MaxUploadBytes: Largest upload body accepted, in bytes. 268435456 is 256 MiB.
Archive.//MaxUploadEntries: Most parts accepted in one multipart body. Raises ASP.NET's own default of 1024, which a large folder would otherwise hit.
